owner: Head of Customer Support (policy owner); FDE student (implementer)
approval: Approved for the capstone prototype by the student acting as policy owner; requires CloudServe sign-off before any live use.
change_note: Replaces policy-v1. Removes three text patterns that were written against specific visible-validation tickets, removes the answerability-classifier gate (held-out AUC 0.32-0.55, i.e. no better than chance), adds billing-dispute, account-compromise and data-location-assurance rules from interview evidence, adds a kill switch, and loads thresholds from a recorded risk-coverage selection.

thresholds.selected_by: evaluation/threshold_selection.py on the held-out calibration split only

rules.name: kill_switch
rules.reason: Automatic answers are switched off by an operator; every ticket goes to a person.
rules.evidence: Governance Framework section 5: a kill switch that works without a deployment.

rules.name: protected_intent
rules.reason: This type of request always needs a specialist.
rules.evidence: Dataset: 101/101 of these intents are labelled must_not_auto_respond. Sofia: security is escalated every time. Ines: no article exists for feature requests or roadmap.

rules.name: security_signal
rules.reason: The message mentions a possible security incident.
rules.evidence: Daniel: anything touching security or account compromise must not be automated.

rules.name: account_compromise_signal
rules.reason: The message suggests the account may be compromised.
rules.evidence: Daniel: account compromise is a protected category.

rules.name: legal_compliance_signal
rules.reason: The message raises a legal or regulatory question.
rules.evidence: Marcus: compliance review in the autumn; Daniel: compliance consequences.

rules.name: roadmap_signal
rules.pattern: \b(feature request|roadmap|when will you (add|support|release)|please add a feature|eta for (the )?(feature|fix))\b
rules.reason: Roadmap and timing questions have no approved answer.
rules.evidence: Ines: anything about roadmap or timing is not covered by the knowledge base.

rules.name: billing_dispute_signal
rules.reason: Billing disputes can become contractual; a person must decide.
rules.evidence: Daniel: nothing automated should be making commitments about money.

rules.name: data_location_assurance
rules.reason: A definitive data-location assurance for compliance needs a specialist.
rules.evidence: Daniel: data location answers are sometimes wrong even from humans and the consequence is a compliance problem. Accepted cost: 13 labelled auto-respond tickets in dev+validation match this rule.
